heard: NASA etched water in 103 languages on a spacecraft. Those sounds live on a small metal plate inside. A poem by Poet Laureate Adalimone shares the space. Over 2.6 million names ride on a microchip, too. The whole ship is NASA's largest ever built. Nine instruments can sniff a single bacterium in ice. 49 flybys of Europa arrive in April 2030. The spacecraft hunts for the water, those 103 voices named.
differences: 'ada limon' heard as 'adalimone' after 'by poet laureate'
